Who we are

Built on craft, finished with care.

Urban Space Limited is a design and finishing company built around one idea: a space is only complete when it is designed, built and cared for by people who take it personally. We work with homeowners, developers and businesses to plan, finish and maintain spaces that feel considered in every corner.

Our mission

To transform every space we touch into a lasting expression of comfort, character and craft, delivered with precision from first sketch to final finish.

Our vision

To become the most trusted name in interior and exterior design and finishing in Nigeria, known for spaces that age beautifully and clients who come back.

What we do

Our services.

Interior Design

We plan interiors around how you actually live and work. Layout, lighting, colour, furniture and finishes, composed as one considered scheme rather than a set of separate decisions.

Space planning Lighting design Furniture & decor Colour & material selection

Exterior Design

Facades, compounds and outdoor living areas designed to hold up to weather and still look considered years later, not just on handover day.

Facade design Landscaping & compound layout Outdoor living areas Gate & fencing design

Finishing Works

The details that make a space feel complete. Painting, tiling, POP ceilings, flooring and carpentry, executed to a standard that survives close inspection.

Painting & POP ceiling Tiling & flooring Carpentry & built ins Fixtures & fittings

Cleaning Services

Post construction and routine cleaning that leaves a finished space genuinely ready to live or work in, not just swept.

Post construction cleaning Deep cleaning Routine maintenance Upholstery & window cleaning
